stories.title: Self Assessment Registration Deadline: 5 October 2026
stories.summary: HMRC has launched an improved Self Assessment registration service. Those who need to file a Self Assessment tax return for the first time for 2025–2026 must register by 5 October 2026 or risk a penalty.

stories.title: Autumn Budget 2026: Expected UK Tax Changes
stories.summary: Analysis of anticipated Autumn Budget 2026 tax changes includes possible removal of the CGT annual exempt amount (currently £3,000) and changes to Business Asset Disposal Relief and other CGT reliefs.

stories.title: HMRC 2026 Tax Update: E-Invoicing via Peppol Announced
stories.summary: HMRC announced that Peppol will be the core interoperability network for e-invoicing in the UK, giving software developers and taxpayers direction ahead of the 2029 e-invoicing mandate.

stories.title: UK Resettlement Scheme Reopened for Afghan Women and Palestinian Refugees
stories.summary: The Home Secretary has reopened the UK Resettlement Scheme, with around a quarter of referrals expected to be Afghan women and girls and Palestinian refugees.

stories.title: New Data Shows Fall in Visas, Asylum Claims and Small Boat Arrivals
stories.summary: New Home Office figures show a drop in visas, asylum claims and small boat arrivals in the year to June 2026. Small boat arrivals totalled 33,000 — a 23% drop compared to the previous year — with 235,000 work visas and 383,000 study visas granted.

stories.title: UK Immigration Rules Changes October 2026
stories.summary: New immigration rules effective October 2026 expand the Victim of Domestic Abuse route and introduce a mechanism allowing the Home Office to vary unsuccessful Long Residence applications into family or private life applications.

stories.title: New UK Sanctions Target Kremlin War Chest, Propagandists and Torturers
stories.summary: The UK has announced a package of 31 new sanctions against Russia, stepping up economic pressure ahead of winter. The measures target Russia's financial capacity, state propagandists, and individuals involved in torture.

stories.title: UK Statement at UN Third Committee: Defending Universal Rights
stories.summary: The UK delivered a statement at the UN Third Committee reaffirming commitment to defend universal human rights without fear or favour.

stories.title: DWP Welfare Reform Takes Effect: Disability Benefit Reassessments Overhauled
stories.summary: From 1 October 2026, the DWP's disability benefit reassessment process has been significantly overhauled as part of the government's welfare reform agenda aimed at reducing the benefits bill and supporting more people into work.

stories.title: Universal Credit Legislation Laid to Tackle Work Disincentives
stories.summary: New Universal Credit legislation has been laid before Parliament to address perverse incentives that discourage work and trap people on long-term benefits.

stories.title: Warm Home Discount Scheme Opens for Applications
stories.summary: The Warm Home Discount Scheme has opened for applications in England, Scotland and Wales from October 2026, providing eligible households with a discount on their energy bills.

stories.title: New 25-Year Farming Roadmap Launched for English Farmers
stories.summary: DEFRA has published a new plan to make English farming profitable, productive, sustainable and resilient. The 25-year Farming Roadmap gives English farmers long-term certainty beyond the next harvest for the first time.

stories.title: Sustainable Farming Incentive 2026 (SFI26) Window 2 Closed
stories.summary: Window 2 of the Sustainable Farming Incentive 2026 has now closed. Around 25% of the Window 2 budget has been allocated based on applications received, with bluetongue reporting measures also updated for livestock keepers.

stories.title: JEF Defence Ministers Issue Joint Statement on Ukraine Support
stories.summary: Defence ministers of the Joint Expeditionary Force issued a statement on 2 October 2026 reaffirming steadfast support for Ukraine. Ukraine participated in the JEF's flagship Lion Protector exercise for the first time, with Ukrainian mine countermeasure vessels operating alongside JEF forces.

stories.title: British Paratrooper Killed by Explosion in Ukraine, Coroner Rules
stories.summary: A British paratrooper has been killed by an explosion in Ukraine, according to a coroner's ruling. The Ministry of Defence has confirmed the death of the servicemember.

stories.title: HMNB Clyde to Receive Three New Floating Docks Through UK-Only Competition
stories.summary: The Ministry of Defence announced that HMNB Clyde will receive three new floating docks through a UK-only competition, sustaining over 350 UK jobs.

stories.title: Business Secretary Backs Investment and Innovation Across UK
stories.summary: The Business Secretary announced backing for investment and innovation to power good growth in every corner of the UK, highlighting the government's industrial strategy approach under the newly merged BIST department.

stories.title: G7 Deal Agreed to Ramp Up AI Adoption Among SMEs
stories.summary: UK Tech Minister Ian Murray returned from the G7 Summit with a newly agreed deal among G7 partners to ramp up AI adoption among small and medium-sized businesses, alongside stronger tech ties and international agreements on AI to modernise public services.

stories.title: AI for Science Strategy Published by BIST
stories.summary: BIST published its AI for Science Strategy, targeting AI as one of six frontier technologies essential to driving growth, with priority areas covering frontier industries. The strategy is underpinned by the Digital and Technologies sector plan.

stories.title: NHS App to Become AI-Powered 'Health Companion' by April 2028
stories.summary: Announced at HETT 2026, the NHS App is set to evolve into an AI-powered personal health companion by April 2028, providing patients with tailored health guidance and service navigation.

stories.title: NHS England Merger with DHSC Targets October 2026
stories.summary: NHS England is targeting October 2026 for integration into the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC), a significant structural reform aimed at streamlining NHS governance and reducing administrative overhead.

stories.title: NHS Changes Patient Referral Process from 1 October 2026
stories.summary: Significant changes to the NHS patient referral process came into effect from 1 October 2026, affecting how patients move through the referral pathway between primary and secondary care.

stories.title: Royal Mail Staff Told to Hide Post to Make Delivery Targets Look Met
stories.summary: BBC investigation reveals Royal Mail staff were instructed to hide undelivered post to make delivery targets appear met. Royal Mail bosses are due to face questions from MPs on Tuesday about the ongoing postal delays affecting millions of people.

stories.title: Royal Mail Fined £21m by Ofcom for Missing Delivery Targets
stories.summary: Ofcom has fined Royal Mail £21 million for missing regulator-set delivery targets. The struggling postal service acknowledged it had improved performance but continued to fall short of required standards.

stories.title: Royal Mail Misses Delivery Targets Again Despite 'Encouraging Signs'
stories.summary: Royal Mail has again missed regulator-set delivery targets but described early indicators as 'encouraging'. The firm faces continued scrutiny over its performance and the handling of postal delays nationwide.
